findings.requirement: .docs/10_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:189 EXIT-P05 criterion2 Stop/decline during degraded connection
findings.title: Keep a specific pending-offer refusal path under degraded metadata/transport
findings.detail: Frozen actualTSX/OwnControls retains session Pause/Stop/Abort positive facts, but treats skip/decline_invitation/withdraw_action as ordinary5-second connected-only grants. GamesPanel hides all visible private invitation/action data when offline. A still-live pending invitation therefore loses its specific Decline after metadata expiry or offline transition, even though whole-game Stop remains. This does not satisfy the explicit Stop/decline requirement and whole-game termination is not evidence of specific offer refusal.
findings.required_fix: Provide a generic specific refusal control using only previously confirmed own bounded round/offer/proposal/session/identity safety facts, without retaining partner/private prompt/condition payload. Keep final POST authority, stale identity/ABA/newround/removal/privateclear/freshfalse denial, no autoaccept, no invented role, and honest unconfirmed state. Add actual degraded Chromium+HTTP refusal regression independent of whole-gameStop.
findings.scope: Confirmed actualmodule UI gap; no independent actualHTTP/browser execution.
